facts.text: Every undergraduate student who enters Winthrop as a freshman must attend up to 18 cultural events before graduation.

sources.title: Cultural Events - Requirement | Winthrop University
sources.quote: By graduation, each undergraduate student who began at Winthrop as a freshman is required to attend three cultural events for every 20 hours completed at Winthrop University, not to exceed a maximum requirement of 18 cultural events.
